[[Wahli's Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Commander Wahli]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Barbarous Shore]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Adamantine Falchion]].
